title.en: An Act Auttiorizing the Leyte State School of Arts and Trade in Tanauan, Leyte, To Offer the Courses Leading To the Degrees of Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering
title.orig: An Act Auttiorizing the Leyte State School of Arts and Trade in Tanauan, Leyte, To Offer the Courses Leading To the Degrees of Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering

text.en: The Leyte State School of Arts and Trade in the Municipality of Tanauan, Leyte, is hereby authorized to offer the courses leading to the degrees of Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
